# Scenario: stream.sni.enabled with Compose default (no routes): unmapped SNI
# TCP-proxies to the TLS backend; managed mock domain still terminates on :443;
# :80 redirect unchanged.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: stream sni compose default fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-shop\.apinfra\.test mode=mock'
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'

docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-shop-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-broker-broker
docker-assert-no-public-ports apinfra_e2e-broker-broker
grep apinfra_proxy_net $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-broker/docker-compose.yml

# Managed domain still works through the SNI front.
# Require body OK: with Compose default, a premature map miss returns HTTP 200
# PASSTHROUGH from the broker, which curl -f would treat as success.
exec sh -c 'for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do body=$(curl -skf --resolve e2e-shop.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-shop.apinfra.test/ 2>/dev/null) || { sleep 1; continue; }; echo "$body" | grep -q OK || { sleep 1; continue; }; printf "%s\n" "$body"; exit 0; done; echo "shop HTTPS never ready" >&2; exit 1'
stdout 'OK'
exec curl -sI --resolve e2e-shop.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-shop.apinfra.test/
stdout '301'

# Unmapped SNI follows Compose default → backend body + cert.
exec sh -c 'for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do curl -skf --resolve mqtt.e2e.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://mqtt.e2e.apinfra.test/ && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "mqtt HTTPS never ready" >&2; exit 1'
stdout 'PASSTHROUGH'
exec sh -c 'curl -skv --resolve mqtt.e2e.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://mqtt.e2e.apinfra.test/ >/dev/null 2>mqtt-tls.err; grep -i "subject:.*mqtt\.e2e\.apinfra\.test" mqtt-tls.err'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
stream:
  sni:
    enabled: true
    default:
      project: e2e-broker
      service-name: broker
      port: 8883
projects:
  - name: e2e-shop
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-shop.apinfra.test
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: mock
  - name: e2e-broker
    enabled: true
    config: {}

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-shop/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-broker/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  broker:
    image: nginx:1.30-alpine
    volumes:
      - ./nginx-tls.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-broker/nginx-tls.conf --
server {
    listen 8883 ssl;
    server_name mqtt.e2e.apinfra.test;
    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/certs/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/certs/privkey.pem;
    location / {
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 'PASSTHROUGH\n';
    }
}
